# Aruba Web Studio

> A web and app studio in Oranjestad, Aruba. Builds websites, mobile apps, APIs and augmented reality for Aruban businesses. Contact: info@arubawebstudio.com. Works in Papiamento, Dutch, Spanish and English.

## What we build, and the published price
- Websites: from $800, about one week. Four to six pages, mobile first, a working contact form, Google listing set up.
- Mobile apps: from $4,500, four to eight weeks. One build for iOS and Android, sharing code with the website.
- APIs: from $1,200, two to four weeks. Connects booking systems, POS and websites.
- Augmented reality: quoted per project.

## How a project works
1. Tell us what the business does (email or call).
2. We build a working site before you pay.
3. If it is not right you owe nothing; if it is, half up front and half at launch.
4. It goes live on your own domain and hosting account.
